svg.title: Lord of Earthly Power: Four of Pentacles · Sun in Capricorn · Chesed (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Sun above the painting and Capricorn below, as Book T places them: "Symbols Sun and Capricorn above and below to represent the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791652732518-kt6fzcsn88.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
